name: nekoweb-mcp-server
description: Manage your Nekoweb website: browse, edit, upload and deploy files, and check site stats.
long_description: Lets Claude browse, read, edit, upload, move and delete the files on your Nekoweb site, deploy a zip of a built site, check your views, followers and API rate limits, change your site settings, find other sites, and keep up with the sites you follow and Nekoweb news.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Generate one at https://nekoweb.org/api. It gives full access to your site's files.

local_root.title: Upload folder (optional)
local_root.description: Only let the upload tools read files inside this folder. Leave empty to allow any file you name.

session_token.title: Session token (optional)
session_token.description: The 'token' cookie from nekoweb.org, for features the API doesn't have, like site tags, stats history, followers and your feed. It gives full access to your account.

tools.name: nekoweb_get_site_info
tools.description: Show a site's title, views, followers and dates

tools.name: nekoweb_list_sites
tools.description: List the sites on your account and their folders

tools.name: nekoweb_get_limits
tools.description: Show remaining API requests

tools.name: nekoweb_list_folder
tools.description: List a folder's contents

tools.name: nekoweb_read_file
tools.description: Read a file's source or view an image

tools.name: nekoweb_write_file
tools.description: Create or replace a text file

tools.name: nekoweb_create
tools.description: Create an empty file or folder

tools.name: nekoweb_upload_file
tools.description: Upload files from your computer

tools.name: nekoweb_import_zip
tools.description: Upload and extract a zip

tools.name: nekoweb_move
tools.description: Rename or move a file or folder

tools.name: nekoweb_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or folder

tools.name: nekoweb_get_site_settings
tools.description: Show a site's settings (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_update_site_settings
tools.description: Change a site's settings (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_get_tags
tools.description: List a site's tags (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_add_tag
tools.description: Add a tag to a site (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_remove_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from a site (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_get_stats_history
tools.description: Show a site's daily views, followers and updates (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_list_followers
tools.description: List the sites that follow a site (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_search_sites
tools.description: Search Nekoweb sites by name or tag

tools.name: nekoweb_get_news
tools.description: Read the latest Nekoweb news

tools.name: nekoweb_get_global_feed
tools.description: Read the newest posts from all Nekoweb sites

tools.name: nekoweb_get_feed
tools.description: Read posts from the sites you follow (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_list_following
tools.description: List the sites you follow (needs the session token)

tools.name: nekoweb_follow_site
tools.description: Follow or unfollow a site (needs the session token)
